messages:
zoe: Quick standup for SkyForge listing + EdgeWorks SI flow. Were T-72h. Need final asset paths, SI verification window, and legal quote.

hassan: Ill take SI verification. Plan to run a full staging deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT. Will need EdgeWorks contact on call.

lia: I received a partial asset bundle (logos + one hero). Missing 3 product shots and SKU CSV. PM says theyll push the rest tonight to s3://skyforge-staging/assets/8972/.

zoe: Embargo is 2026-05-05T12:00:00Z. Everything public must be approved by 2026-05-04T12:00:00Z. No exceptions.

todd: Landing copy draft is in /staging/marketplace/skyforge/ — I swapped the benchmark numbers for qualitative language pending eng verification.

hassan: SI runbook short (copy):
```
- git checkout marketplace/skyforge
- deploy connector v1.4.0
- run smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku SKYF-PLUS
- run e2e: ./ci/e2e.sh --partner edgeworks --env staging
- verify: grep "handshake complete" /var/log/redwood/connector.log
- upload results to Partnerships/SkyForge/tests
```
If firmware mismatch, follow fallback: publish listing but tag "deploy disabled" and add partner contact.

lia: Good to accept progressive image updates — we can use low-res for preview but final must be 3x retina for hero. I marked non-compliant images in the tracker.

qa-bot: regression-check started (id: 3321)
qa-bot: regression-check found 1 minor CSS anomaly in price-band component (non-blocking).

zoe: Two action items for green: 1) @lia confirm final CDN path and filename scheme; 2) @todd confirm we have legal-approved partner quote in copy.

todd: Legal asked for a partner-signed quote. Lia, did SkyForge marketing confirm wording?

lia: I asked them for a 1-2 sentence quote (performance + partnership). They replied with a draft; legal requested small wording tweaks. Expect final by tomorrow 07:00 PT.

hassan: I booked EdgeWorks engineer for 09:00 PT run and reserved a 30m slot. If anything fails we do the soft-launch fallback (listing + docs + "integration pending").

deploy-bot: preview-check running (job 9342)
deploy-bot: preview-check passed 44c all links resolvable, meta tags present

zoe: Also, marketing wants a high-res hero for the blog (1200px min). Lia  can you push that to CDN or confirm availability?

lia: Hero will be in s3://skyforge-staging/assets/8972/hero_3x.png by 06:30 PT tomorrow. Ill update tracker when uploaded.

todd: Reminder: analytics needs partner.sku_id and partner.region in event payload. Filed INF-8350.

zoe: OK. If we have no major blockers by 08:00 PT tomorrow we mark "launch-ready" and schedule the final dry-run at 09:00 PT. Please post any test screenshots and the legal quote here.

hassan: Will post run results. Ready to start at 09:00.

lia: Uploaded hero and product shots; filenames: hero_3x.png, product1_3x.png, product2_3x.png. CDN path: https://cdn.redwood.example/partners/skyforge/8972/.

qa-bot: smoke-run completed 44d no critical failures detected

zoe: Great work team. Final note: document everything in Partnerships/Marketplace/SkyForge/launch-playbook.md and tag approvals in the tracker. Well only flip embargo if legal, eng, and marketing have "approved-for-publish" tags. Thanks!
